name: RedReplier - social listening and lead finder
description:
RedReplier watches Reddit, X, Hacker News and Bluesky for posts and comments that mention your product, your competitors or buying-signal phrases. It scores every mention from 0 to 100 for how likely it is to be a real lead, so you only open the threads worth replying to.

From Claude you can: list the latest mentions across all your websites, filtered by source, status, score or date, and count matches before paging through them; see why a mention was scored the way it was, with its tags; approve real leads, reject noise or reset a mention to new; add, update or delete monitored websites and have RedReplier write a website description from its URL; add, edit, disable, re-enable or delete keywords; preview what extra keywords would cost and check your monthly keyword-edit allowance; and turn email alerts on or off and set how often the digest arrives. Twenty tools in total.

Sign in with your RedReplier account. You need at least one monitored website with keywords to get mentions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add RedReplier - social listening and lead finder to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add RedReplier - social listening and lead finder to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.redreplier.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the RedReplier - social listening and lead finder MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: RedReplier - social listening and lead finder lists 20 MCP tools, including add_keywords, analyze_website, count_mentions, create_website, delete_keyword, delete_website, disable_keyword, edit_keyword, enable_keyword, explain_mention, get_alert_settings, and get_website.

_published_faq.name: Does RedReplier - social listening and lead finder MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: RedReplier - social listening and lead finder requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

acceptedAnswer.text: RedReplier - social listening and lead finder is developed by RedReplier. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
